info.title: dotnet-tokenledger
info.description: dotnet tokenledger: compares the TokenLedger baselines of two git refs and lists, per scenario, the regressions, behavior changes and improvements in model calls, tokens, tools and estimated cost, as text, Markdown (for pull request comments) or JSON. Also creates pricing.json from the models your scenarios use, and summarizes what the whole suite costs.

options.name: --format
options.description: text (default), markdown or json.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to a file instead of the console.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
diff exits with code 1 on: regression, change (any difference, new or removed
scenario), or never (default).

options.name: --tolerance
options.description: Relative token change to ignore. Default: 0.10.

options.name: --pricing
options.description: Prices to use instead of each folder's pricing.json.

options.name: --dir
options.description: The TokenLedger folder name. Default: tokenledger.

options.name: --currency
options.description: Currency of a new pricing.json. Default: USD.
